style_brief.brand_voice: Warm, community-driven, and down-to-earth — the voice of a volunteer-run small-town ball association that speaks directly to families, players, coaches, and sponsors like neighbours. Tone is encouraging and practical, mixing genuine gratitude (especially toward sponsors and volunteers) with a playful, fun-loving streak (the adult softball "Did Ya Know?" rule explainers and country-music sponsor thank-yous). Information is delivered clearly and helpfully so parents and coaches always know what to do next.

props.body:
**Communication:**

Please pay attention to the requirements for the upcoming season. If all proper documentation is not provided by the start of the season, Coaches will not be permitted on the field with the children.

On the Sports Engine APP there will be a COACHES CHAT set up — where ALL coaches can ask questions in regards to practices, Games, etc. All coaches are encouraged to share practice plans, best practices, tricks and tips! All LLL Board members and Coaching coordinators will be on this CHAT in order to provide information to Coaches ALL AT ONCE.

blocks.source_brief: Communication section about season requirements and the Sports Engine Coaches Chat.
blocks.source_quote: On the Sports Engine APP – there will be a COACHES CHAT set up – where ALL coaches can ask questions in regards to practices, Games, etc. – All coaches are encouraged to share practice plans, best practices, tricks and tips!

props.body:
**Documentation:**

When you registered to participate as a Coach you were provided with Documents to review and sign off on during registration.

We also require **3 items** from all coaches to be forwarded back to our Coaching Coordinator **before May 1, 2025**:

1. **Child Abuse & Prevention Policy Sign-off & Course Completion**
   - Visit: https://www.littleleague.org/player-safety/child-protection-program/safesport-resources-parents/
   - Click the link and scroll to "Abuse Awareness for Adults"
   - Create an account (or log in if you already have one), take the course, and receive your certificate
   - A copy of your certificate will be emailed to you and is also accessible under your online account

2. **Vulnerable Sector Check Letter (Police Clearance)**
   - Clearance letter to be filled out and brought to the Langdon RCMP Detachment to get completed — this is **free of cost**
   - Police Checks are ONLY valid for 1 year — please bring the attached form to the Langdon RCMP Detachment

3. **NCCP Safe Sport Training & The Rule of Two**
   - Go to [www.coach.ca](http://www.coach.ca/) and take the **Safe Sport Training** and **Understanding the Rule of Two** (separate courses, both free)
   - You will register and be given an NCCP#. Safe Sport Training takes less than an hour; Rule of Two takes approximately 20 minutes
   - For **Safe Sport Training**: scroll to "Create a Safe Sport Environment", select 'Safe Sport Training', choose 'Baseball', complete the course, and send proof to your Coordinator
   - For **Rule of Two**: log into coach.ca, click 'eLearning', go to Multi-sport, scroll to 'Understanding the Rule of Two', complete the course, and send proof to your Coordinator

Please email all copies and documents to:
**Caitie** — [strikersbaseball.coachcoord@gmail.com](mailto:strikersbaseball.coachcoord@gmail.com)

props.body:
**2026 Langdon Days – Sponsorship Packages**

On behalf of Langdon Little League, we would like to sincerely thank you for your generous support. We are excited to announce that we have been granted a five-year occupancy for the six baseball diamonds in Langdon. With this new opportunity, we are increasing our efforts in sponsorship and fundraising to meet the vital goals of enhancing our leagues and benefiting the community of Langdon.

Your sponsorship is helping us achieve a vision that will significantly improve our facilities and provide greater opportunities for both our current athletes and future generations. With your support, we are working toward expanding our complex to include essential amenities such as:

- A new building with a concession and bathrooms
- Change room facilities
- An indoor training gym and batting cages
- Lighting for our fields
- Shade trees to enhance the outdoor experience
- An all-inclusive playground for the enjoyment of families and children of all abilities

Your contribution also helps make our dreams of establishing a local academy program a reality. This will allow us to keep our athletes here in Langdon, rather than losing them to city programs that are already at capacity. In the future, we will be able to host National and International events, bringing even more exposure and opportunity to the Langdon community.

In recognition of your invaluable support, we will proudly advertise your business at our facilities and during our events. We want to ensure your contributions are acknowledged as a key part of the success and growth of Langdon Little League.

What we are building today is not just for this generation of children, but for many generations to come. Thank you for helping us make this vision a reality.

Warm regards,
